
## 2024-05-18 - Optimize base64 parsing in fileReader
**Learning:** For large base64 strings generated by FileReader from files, using `.split(',')[1]` creates unnecessary intermediate array allocations and causes high memory overhead.
**Action:** Always prefer `.substring(result.indexOf(',') + 1)` over `.split(',')[1]` when extracting the base64 payload from a Data URL, as it performs significantly better for large files.
